integrity: The proof is self-contained; included code enumerates all distinct finite factors for designated test lengths and checks derived identities, rather than establishing infinite claims by enumeration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns one nonrecurrent one-sided sequence and one leading-zero variant; it does not classify arbitrary sparse automatic sequences. Exact priority remains subject to discovery of unindexed equivalents. Finite tests are not an infinite proof.
title: Exact reflection and factor profiles for the characteristic powers-of-two word
